name: Mebuta Hitozuma, Haramaserareru 2
original_name: 雌豚人妻,孕ませられる2
source: Continuing from the previous installment, it tells the story of how the protagonist, Hammer, gradually trains Michiko, and in the process, turns her stepson into his own sex toy as well.
translation: 故事承接前作。主角哈默逐步調教美智子，在此過程中，也把她的繼子變成了自己的性玩具。
